solution_components.name: Microsoft Copilot for Security
solution_components.role: Turns security telemetry into incident summaries, queries, reports, and recommended response steps.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Intune
solution_components.role: Applies centralized device management, policy, and remote support across endpoints.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Defender XDR
solution_components.role: Correlates cross-domain security signals for investigation and response.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Defender Threat Intelligence
solution_components.role: Adds threat context that enriches investigations and helps assess blast radius.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Sentinel
solution_components.role: Serves as the SIEM layer that collects telemetry and supports threat detection, investigation, and response.

business_outcome: By integrating Copilot for Security with Microsoft's security stack, we have created a unified command center for investigations, threat intelligence, and incident response. This easy-to-adopt solution has empowered us to build a next-gen Security Operations Center (SOC).
architecture_clues: Security signals from Intune, Defender XDR, Defender Threat Intelligence, and Sentinel are pulled into Copilot for Security, where analysts generate summaries, investigations, reports, and response guidance from the combined context.

The company integrated Microsoft Copilot for Security into its applications, customizing it to work with Microsoft Intune, Defender XDR, Defender Threat Intelligence, and Sentinel, based on Microsoft's recommendations.

LTIMindtree embedded Microsoft Copilot for Security within its applications, customizing the solution to integrate with Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Defender Threat Intelligence and Microsoft Sentinel, following recommendations from the Microsoft team. Committed to partner with Microsoft, LTIMindtree was one of the early adopters of Security Copilot across the globe. It was the first customer in India to start with Early Access Program and go live with General Availability.

Copilot for Security now summarizes incidents and converts vast data signals into key insights to detect cyberthreats before they cause harm. It enhances understanding of the entities involved by leveraging information from Microsoft Defender Threat Intelligence (MDTI). The solution helps assess an incident's blast radius, ensuring no potential threats are overlooked. Microsoft Copilot for Security enables the LTIMindtree team to summarize investigations, incidents, and threats, generating customizable, ready-to-share reports with relevant information in minutes. Chandan Pani, Chief Information Security Officer, LTIMindtree, says, “Microsoft Security Copilot is our true AI partner in cyber defense. It provides AI-enabled automated incident response, integrated threat intelligence and advanced threat analysis. With adaptive detection engineering, it improves future responses and generates more accurate detection rules.”
